content.thinking: PYTHONPATH=/opt/deps is set in env; my script runs from /workspace but `python3 scratch/policy_check.py` has sys.path[0]=scratch. Add /workspace to path.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
p = 'scratch/policy_check.py'
s = open(p).read()
s = s.replace("import json, math, os, selectors, subprocess, sys",
              "import json, math, os, selectors, subprocess, sys\nsys.path.insert(0, '/workspace')")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
timeout 175 python3 scratch/policy_check.py
